verdict.rationale: AMD's product page confirms FSR ("Redstone") support on the RX 9070 XT, and third-party review corroborates strong raster/ray-tracing performance, but the evidence pack lacks detail on frame-generation specifics or a documented list of supported games. missing for 10: explicit frame-generation (FSR 3/4) feature naming, game compatibility list/count, independent hands-on upscaling benchmarks.
